scope: Round 2 over the CURRENT bytes of the four zh-CN chat-surface namespaces: ui.chat 115 keys, ui.chat.canonical 60, ui.chat.run_details 82, ui.chat.asks 26 = 283 keys, each read against its English source, its en context sidecar entry and the consuming component. The delta since round 1 is four values: ui.chat.canonical supplement.details.attempts and .model (half-width ':' -> full-width '：'), ui.chat.run_details chip.todos_closed (待办已全部取消 -> 待办已全部结束), ui.chat.asks close_asks (关闭请求 -> 关闭请求面板), plus one key the source fix added, ui.chat.run_details.todos.hidden_summary. ui.chat is byte-identical to the round-1 target hash, so it carries no delta; the three changed namespaces were re-read in full, not only at the changed keys.
method: Bound to the bytes first: recomputed sha256 for all four en files and all four zh-CN files from disk and compared them with the round-2 manifest (four zh-CN rows) and the task brief (four en values). All eight matched before any judgement; the recomputation is in execution_log.

Mechanical, by running the repository's own catalogue gates (generate --check, check-duplicates, check-strings, context-parity) and then verifying independently with a script of my own: key-set equality in both directions, key order identical to the English source, ICU argument names and argument types identical, every select arm identical (agents/teams/other, agents/teams/skills/other), balanced ICU braces, no backtick code spans or Rich/JSX tags added or dropped, JSON parses.

Plurals against the locale, not against English: Intl.PluralRules('zh-CN').resolvedOptions().pluralCategories is ['other'], so every zh plural carrying only `other` is the guide's mandated shape and not a dropped arm; the new todos.hidden_summary was rendered through the repo's own IntlMessageFormat at 0/1/2/5/1000, and so were the four neighbouring run_details chips.

Accuracy read against source context: meaning, omissions, additions, negation and polarity (a script listed every source string with a negation and checked the Chinese carries one, and the reverse direction for invented negation), plus safe wording for the destructive and permission-bearing strings (sound.stop.*, monitors/wakes cancel, dismiss.refused, approve/deny answers). The error, provider-error, send-failure, transcript and ask copy that a reader meets when something has gone wrong was read a second time, independently of the first pass.

Idiom/register against the zh-CN guide: 你 only (0 occurrences of 您), verb-forward terse labels, no 。 on short status words that the source leaves bare, full-width punctuation in prose, …… for ellipsis, no 啦/哦/呀, no ！.

Terminology against i18n/glossary.md and the shipped zh-CN catalogues for every glossary term these four namespaces actually use: 会话 session, 智能体 agent, 子智能体 subagent, 记录/会话记录 transcript, 唤醒 wake, 监控 monitor, 审批 approvals, 工作区 workspace, 后台任务 job, 运行详情 run details, 待办事项 to-dos, 敏感信息 secret, 凭据 credentials, 授权 grant, plus the kept-Latin runs Local Operator, Radient, Radient Pass, Radient Automatic, MCP, SVG, Enter, Esc, yes/no, Approve/Deny.

Fit: the only two sidecar width budgets in these four namespaces were counted by cell width (choose_model maxCells 18 -> 8 cells; last_reading maxCells 16 -> 8 cells), and every string was measured for cell width; one short-slot string exceeds 1.8x its English (jobs 4 -> 8 cells, a section header). No pixel or rendered-frame claim is made.

Adjacent-breakage checks of the kind the remediation could plausibly disturb: label-in-name (the changed close_asks feeds both aria-label and tooltip of one icon button, so no visible/accessible mismatch), joined fragments (error_block before/after pairs, question_dock prefix+body, the composer chip LABEL_SEAM, the new hidden_summary standing alone), client-owned approval words (APPROVAL_OPTIONS prints the Latin Approve/Deny and the typed answers yes/no/1/2, and the zh hints keep exactly those tokens), typography, NFC and manual bidi controls, over all 283 values.

Round-1 resolution checked last: the round-1 receipt was opened only after my own read, and each of its three findings (one blocker, two minors) was compared with the current bytes. No round-1 finding was declined; all three were fixed in the bytes audited here.

round1_resolution.check: Re-read the consumer: run-detail-model.ts todoClause() returns this key when openTodos === 0 and droppedTodos > 0, so at least one item was abandoned but the rest may have been completed. 取消 is this namespace's own word for a dropped item (todos.dropped = ——已取消, the inline settled tag), so the round-1 text claimed every item was cancelled and repeated the dropped tag beside it. 结束 keeps the neutral settled reading and does not collide with 待办已全部解决 (todos_resolved).

observations_not_findings: PRE-EXISTING and unchanged, declined or carried by round 1 rather than actioned; recorded here so the next wave can decide: ui.chat.canonical.sound.stop.warning renders EN 'The provider has no cancellation endpoint.' as 提供商没有取消接口。 The glossary's wave-2 kept-English set keeps `endpoint` Latin in every locale, while shipped zh-CN has both 接口 (here) and 端点 (ui.agentMessages.settings.consent.no_record). Real, small, and outside this round's remediation scope; the rephrase that avoids the term entirely is 提供商无法取消生成。生成仍会继续，若产出音频则会计费。系统只能尽力停止，不保证取消成功或免于计费。

PRE-EXISTING and unchanged: ui.chat.canonical.supplement.file_actions.open_in_canvas renders as 在Canvas中打开 while every other shipped zh-CN string naming that pane says 画布 (画布视图, 打开画布, 在画布中打开文档). One Latin sibling survives (ui.common.file_actions.show_in_canvas -> 在Canvas中显示), so the family is the pane owner's call, not this round's.

CODE-OWNED typography, not catalogue defects: (a) the error_block family joins `{before} {link}{' '}{after}` with literal JSX spaces, so zh readers see an ASCII space on each side of the Latin link label; (b) LABEL_SEAM is ' — ' (U+2014 with ASCII spaces), so every composer chip renders 在运行详情中打开计划 — 3项待办未完成 with Western dash spacing instead of the zh —— with no spaces; (c) provider_error.headline.out_of_credits places {status} after 额度已用尽, and that argument arrives carrying its own leading ASCII space before ' (HTTP 402)'. Nothing in the catalogue can remove punctuation the component or the wire inserts.

CONSIDERED AND ACCEPTED on the second pass, not findings: ui.chat.asks.dismiss.moot.note reads 无需继续等待 for EN 'stop waiting on it', whose sidecar says the actor is the agent and never a second-person address to the operator - the Chinese is subjectless rather than second-person and states the consequence the button produces, so it does not invert the actor. ui.chat.question_dock.secret_answer_label names the secret-answer form 填写敏感信息, a verb phrase where the sidecar asks for a noun phrase; it is understandable in place and was cleared in round 1, so it is not reopened here.

Widths: the new todos.hidden_summary uses ICU ::group-off on purpose (sidecar says a bare # would group 1000 as 1,000), which is why it renders 已隐藏1000项 while the header sibling ui.chat.run_details.todos.hidden, whose count is pre-formatted by formatNumber in run-detail-todos.tsx:290, renders 已隐藏1,234项. The mismatch is inherited from the English pair (1000 hidden vs 1,234 hidden) and is not a translation defect.
